definitions.support: retained_2d+retained_3d after TrackRGBD, nonnull MapPoint and !outlier; not complete PoseOptimization edges
definitions.timestamp_matching: frame stamps exact across runs; evaluation rounded timestamp nearest unique within 2 microseconds; no interpolation
definitions.rpe_support: support and actions at RPE start; forward approximately 1s error from saved evaluator
definitions.gt_motion: same unique nearest GT matches as frozen evaluator, <=20ms; relative endpoint translation/rotation, offline only

statistics: Pearson and Spearman descriptive only, no p values or iid confidence intervals
residual correlations after OLS fixed 2s phase indicators plus GT 1s displacement and rotation
first-difference correlation within consecutive RPE-start pairs
paired differences relative S0 at same timestamps, raw and phase/motion adjusted
quartile support bins per run; data-dependent descriptive edges, no threshold claim
window_selection: fixed disjoint physical 2s bins [0,2),...,[18,20), only RPE pairs with both endpoints inside; rank bins by max(S1 RMS RPEt - S0 RMS RPEt,S2 RMS RPEt - S0 RMS RPEt), select top 3; outcome-selected exploratory, never altered by count patterns
